verdict.rationale: The product ships its own first-party command-line helpers: six standard-library Python scripts that don't touch the network, such as `python3 replica-design/contrast.py` for WCAG token checks. These are scattered utility scripts rather than a unified official CLI. The slash commands and `/plugin install` run inside Claude Code, which is the host platform, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a single packaged CLI binary or entry point, documented subcommands and flags, CLI-driven execution of the core recon/plan/build/ship workflow, and independent corroboration.
